page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top, page number at top right. Two round coin portraits with legends above the text. Running text below in one column. Signature at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: IMP CAES FRIDERICVS AVG
IMP HENRICHVS VI AVG
FRIDERICVS, huius nominis primus, natione Sueuus,
cognomento Aenobarbus, à colore barbæ ruffæ, nepos Con-
radi ex fratre, post eundem Conradum tertium Romæ impe-
rat anno mundi 5114. à Christo nato 1152. Hic Dertonam
(nunc Tortonam vocant) portas sibi claudere ausam, obses-
sam capit: inde Romam contendens ab Adriano coronatur.
Euersa Dertona quæ in partibus Alexandri stabat, in cuius lo-
cum Octauianum Pontificem crearat, Mediolanum inde solo
æquat: Galliámque omnem Cisalpinam eadem sentientem
vastat: tertiò & quartò Italiam intrans Alexandrum fugat.
Tandem Friderici filio, nauali prælio victo, utitur Fridericus
summa humilitate: nam pro templi foribus humi prostratus
ante Pontificem, pedibus eius se opprimi permittit. Pontifex
clamari præcipit, Super aspidem & basiliscum ambulabis, & concul-
cabis leonem, & draconem, ac tum eum absoluit. Fridericus eam
à se exhiberi humilitatem Petro, non Alexandro, dixit: respon-
dit Alexander, & mihi & Petro. Hic deinde Saracenos ac Tur-
cas prostrauit, Sultanum in Aegyptum fugauit: verùm capta
iam Armenia, cùm in equo rapidum amnem ingreditur,
strenuissimus heros perit, anno imperij 37. Egna.lib.3.
HENRICVS Friderici filius post patrem imperat anno
mundi 5151. à Christo nato 1189. huic Papa Clemens tertius
Constantiam virginem sacram, Rogerij Normani filiam, vxo-
rem dedit. Siciliam obtinuit, Tancredo spurio expugnato. Phi-
lippum fratrem, qui postea imperat, cum exercitu in Syriam
misit: ducibus etiam Archiepiscopo Maguntino, & Saxoniæ
Duce existentibus. Aemy. lib. 6. Blond. lib. 6. Egna. lib. 3. im-
perat ann. 10.

page.notes: Two round coin portraits with legends: left "IMP CAES FRIDERICVS AVG", right "IMP HENRICHVS VI AVG". Legends transcribed as lines. The first medallion's legend is curved, so the reading of the wording is firm but the arrangement around the coin is approximate. Long s is written as plain s. Printed "vtitur" and "vxorem" are given as "utitur" and "vxorem" per the u/v rule. Printed spelling otherwise kept.
